subject: Funding path & token economics — confirm budget owner and next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@fincode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Recap: token volumes, target $/1M, and who signs (next steps)

Thanks again for taking the time today, Priya — good discussion. Quick recap and asks so we can move toward a procurement-ready package: 

Summary of what we heard (please correct if I mis-stated):
- Primary use: customer support + outbound summarization + fraud triage.
- Expected steady-state generation: ~300M tokens/month in year 1, ramping to ~900M/mo in year 2.
- Short-term peak windows (quarterly events) could push up to ~1.5B tokens in a month.
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: ideally in the ballpark of $200–$300 per 1M generated tokens for committed volume (you said you’d aim for ~250).
- Budget range you have visibility into for this initiative: preliminary range $60k–$120k/yr (open to confirm).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer + who will approve budget (name & email).
2) Confirm procurement contact for PO/contract routing (if different from econ buyer).
3) If the token numbers above look off, send a corrected monthly token estimate (CSV is fine).
4) I attached a one-page pricing sheet and a simple SOW draft to start — we’ll produce a single-sheet "budget ask" with options (commit tiers + expected $/1M) once we have confirmation on the owner and target budget.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing scenarios), draft-sow-v1.pdf (template)

Proposed timeline: we can have a procurement-ready ask + tailored unit-econ calc by end of next week if we get the econ buyer + procurement contact today/tomorrow.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call with Marcus/finance if that helps.

—Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@fincode.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: token volumes, target $/1M, and who signs (next steps)

Hi Connor — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Volume: for internal planning please use 300M tokens/month year 1 -> 900M by year 2 (the 1.5B peak is a conservative max for Q4 events).
- Budget: current allocation for pilot & 2026 proof-of-value is roughly $60k–$120k (we'd prefer lower mid-point if unit econ works).
- Economic buyer: Marcus Dale, CFO (marcus.dale@fincode.com) — he’ll own final approval for pricing/commit.
- Procurement contact: Anna Park (anna.procure@fincode.com) — she handles PO/contract routing and vendor setup.

I’m attaching our procurement contacts list to make routing easier. Marcus is aware we’re evaluating options; he’ll want a clear "budget ask" line-item that shows cost per month and expected spend over 12 months for each commit tier.

Attachment: procurement-contacts.csv

Ping me if you want a quick alignment call with Marcus and Anna — I can set it up.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Product Operations, FinCo Payments
priya.rao@fincode.com | +1 (212) 555-0987

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@fincode.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 11:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: token volumes, target $/1M, and who signs (next steps)

Thanks Priya — great, that helps a lot. Connor and I spoke offline and built 3 quick budget options to present to Marcus: 

Option A (Pilot / Low commitment)
- Commit: 300M tokens/month
- Effective price: $320 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$96k (note: this is a higher $/1M because of low commit)

Option B (Growth commit)
- Commit: 600M tokens/month
- Effective price: $260 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$156k

Option C (Enterprise committed)
- Commit: 1B tokens/month
- Effective price: $220 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$220k

We can also structure a stepped ramp for year 1 -> year 2 to smooth the economics. These are draft numbers to get budget-level alignment only; final pricing will depend on SLA, data controls, and term.

Next steps I propose:
- Connor to produce a one-page "budget ask" that shows A/B/C above with annualized cost and expected $/1M. (Connor: can you include the unit-econ calc showing cost per 1M and incremental savings with caching/quantization?)
- If Marcus confirms he’s the approver, Anna for procurement, we’ll schedule a 15-min sync to confirm timelines and contract path.
- I attached a draft SOW and the pricing-sheet I referenced — please review and flag any must-haves for the legal/procurement teams.

Attachments: draft-sow-v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Connor — happy to co-present the budget ask to Marcus if helpful.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-7788

From: Marcus Dale <marcus.dale@fincode.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Park <anna.procure@fincode.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@fincode.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: token volumes, target $/1M, and who signs (next steps)

Connor / Marissa — I’m the economic buyer and will own the budget decision for this initiative. A few requests from finance before we can commit: 

1) Please send a single-sheet "budget ask" that lists: monthly spend, annualized spend, and cost per 1M tokens for each proposed commit tier (A/B/C). Show one row with expected first-year spend given the ramp Priya mentioned.
2) Include assumptions: avg tokens per request, expected token mix (prompt vs completion), and any anticipated savings from caching/quantization.
3) Procurement: we use PO + Net30; Anna will handle vendor setup. Please provide standard W-9 and an initial SOW.

If you can get that to me by Tuesday EOD I can get preliminary finance approval the following week. Happy to do a 15-min call Mon/Tue morning if you prefer.

Attachment: fin-approval-criteria.pdf

Regards,
Marcus Dale
CFO, FinCo Payments
marcus.dale@fincode.com | +1 (646) 555-2201
